# FEVIQO

> FEVIQO is a premier unlimited video editing agency and creative post-production studio providing dedicated video editors, 24–48h turnaround, and Turkish drama Urdu subtitle streaming portals.

## Core Navigation & Services

- [Homepage](https://feviqo.com/): FEVIQO creative video post-production agency, showreel, and unlimited video editing subscriptions.
- [Unlimited Video Editing](https://feviqo.com/unlimited-editing/): Flat-rate monthly editing plans with dedicated lead editors and unlimited revisions.
- [Pricing Plans](https://feviqo.com/pricing/): Transparent subscription tiers for creators, brands, and agencies with no lock-in contracts.
- [Content Creators](https://feviqo.com/creators/): High-retention editing for YouTube, TikTok (9:16), Reels, and podcasts.
- [Agencies](https://feviqo.com/agencies/): Scalable white-label video editing pods for marketing agencies and growth teams.
- [Business & Brands](https://feviqo.com/business/): Direct-response performance video ads, VSLs, and product launch assets.
- [Video Showcase](https://feviqo.com/gallery/): Filterable video portfolio and showreel showcase across short-form and long-form formats.
- [Book a Strategy Call](https://feviqo.com/booking/): 1-on-1 creative strategy and onboarding consultation.
- [About FEVIQO](https://feviqo.com/about/): Agency leadership, creative directors, and company background.

## Turkish Drama Portals

- [Turkish Dramas Directory](https://feviqo.com/dramas/): Comprehensive streaming index of premium Turkish television series with Urdu subtitles.
- [Mehmed: Fetihler Sultanı](https://feviqo.com/mehmed-fetihler-sultani/): Historical drama series detailing Sultan Mehmed II's conquests with high-definition Urdu subtitles.
- [Mehmed Episode 89](https://feviqo.com/mehmed-fetihler-sultani/episode-89/): Official streaming page for Episode 89 (Bolum 89) in 1080p HD.
- [Teşkilat Season 7](https://feviqo.com/teskilat/): Turkish espionage and intelligence agency action series with Urdu subtitles.
- [Teşkilat Episode 189](https://feviqo.com/teskilat/episode-189/): Official streaming portal for Episode 189 (Bolum 189).
- [Güneşin Doğduğu Yer](https://feviqo.com/gunesin-dogdugu-yer/): Emotional family drama portal with Urdu subtitles.
